_: THE NIGHT ON THE CLOCK — the law of a table played on time rather than in a room's queue. A moment is an ADDRESS on this table's clock (spine:temporal — day, gathering, beat). Every character SAYS what they do at the beat they stand in, in their own mirror (temporal:<handle>), where all can read it; the keeper FOLDS every line at that address into what happened — THE NIGHT, the block named temporal, one fold per address, kept under the keeper's key alone; and each player is TOLD it in their character's own thread (tree:temporal:<handle>). A coarser address holds a longer span, so zooming out in time is saying and folding one rung up. Three blocks share a word: spine:temporal is the clock, temporal:<handle> is a mirror, and temporal alone is THE NIGHT. THE DOOR COMPOSES EACH ACT'S READS: pscale_play(world=<this table>, handle, secret) is a character's door and says what is owed; pscale_stream_engage(field='temporal', handle, at=<address>, beach=<this table>, tier='soft') composes THE TELLING, tier='medium' THE FOLD, tier='hard' THE LEAN — run THE CALL as the system text over THE INPUT, and act on the third section. A seat with bsp alone walks the reads each branch names. Do the one act your seat is for, by the branch that names it.

1._: A CHARACTER'S TURN, in order. THE DOOR FINDS YOU: pscale_play(world=<this table>, handle=<yours>, secret=<your key>) reads your passport — its third line, 'Location: *:<beach>:<block>:<digits>' is where you stand and 'Beat: *:<beach>:spine:temporal:<address>' is when — and lays out the night so far, what stands at your beat, and THE ACTS OWED in order: (1) a fold standing at your Beat address that your thread does not yet tell — tell it: pscale_stream_engage(tier='soft', at=<that address>) composes the telling; write it, then keep it once: pscale_stream_engage(at=<that address>, keep='personal', keep_text=<the telling>, secret=<your key>) — and write your passport's third line again with the Beat address changed to the one after NEXT at the fold's end (and the Location digits changed if it ended WAY <digits> for you): bsp(block='passport:<you>', spindle='3', content=<the whole line>, secret); (2) then SAY at the beat you now stand in: pscale_stream_engage(at=<beat>, say=<your line>, secret) — the character's own act and words, present tense, third person, what anyone there could see and hear, speech word for word, only your own half: never another's answer, never the outcome. One say per beat, then stop: the fold is the keeper's. To settle for a night or a journey instead of acting at the beat, follow branch 4 — from a quiet beat only.
1.1: FIND NOW — the passport is the only place your standpoint lives, and a seat that remembers nothing finds itself there. Without the door: read your passport whole (it is small); read THE NIGHT at your gathering — bsp block='temporal', spindle=<your beat with its last digit made 0>, pscale_attention=0 — to see what has been folded (the ladder the engage shows is the CLOCK's face; only this read shows the night); when that ring is empty — a new gathering, a new day — the story so far is THE FOLD JUST BEFORE NOW: the last day's fold, whole. A Beat line naming a coarser address: the same read at that address shows the beats folded beneath it since you said there (1.5).
1.2: THE TELLING — render a folded address for your player: second person, present tense, FROM WHERE THE CHARACTER STANDS — every act and every spoken word the fold holds that they could see or hear, whole and in order, nothing added; what happened beyond their sight reaches them only as its signs did, or not at all; names only as the night has spoken them; close where it leaves the player to act. Keep it once with pscale_stream_engage(at=<the folded address>, keep='personal', keep_text=<the telling>, secret=<your key>) — one telling per folded address, never twice. The thread is your character's whole story and nobody else's to open.
1.3: SAY — the character's own act and words at this beat: pscale_stream_engage(at=<beat>, say=<the line>, secret=<your key>). Present tense, third person, what anyone there could see and hear: the deed plain, speech word for word, others by appearance until a name has been spoken aloud. Only your own half — never another's answer, never the outcome, never a thing the night has not given you. The fold quotes your words as you said them: what you say is what happens. Revisable until the fold, never after.
1.4: TO GO ELSEWHERE, say the going; if the fold lets you go it ends with WAY <place address>, and only then do you write that address into your passport's Location line. Until the fold says WAY you have not moved.
1.5: TO ZOOM OUT — a scene's rest, a night's sleep, a day's walk — follow branch 4: ENGAGE your beat first, and only if it is quiet say your disposition for the span at the COARSER ADDRESS that contains now instead of at the beat — a scene's rest at the gathering (your beat's last digit made 0), a night's sleep or a day's walk at the day (its last two made 0) — say nothing finer, and WRITE THAT COARSER ADDRESS INTO YOUR PASSPORT'S BEAT LINE: the standpoint lives only there, and a seat that remembers nothing must find you standing at the day. When that address is folded, its fold's NEXT is where you stand. If instead a BEAT beneath it has been folded since you said there, the night pulled you back: the door names it; tell that beat, write its NEXT into your Beat line, and play on.

2._: THE FOLD is the keeper's alone, one per address, and only when ripe — every character standing at this address has said, or the span has plainly passed. THE DOOR COMPOSES IT: pscale_stream_engage(field='temporal', handle=<the keeper's>, at=<the address>, beach=<this table>, tier='medium') gives THE CALL (this branch and its ring), THE INPUT (the voices at the address, the night so far at each rung, the actors as their passports stand, the place's public faces, each actor's luck already rolled, the rules) and THE CLAIM — which address is ripe, by each passport's Beat line and by the voices standing beneath. WHICH ADDRESS IS RIPE is yours to find, not given: if any Beat line names a coarser address than the beat, read 2.3 before you fold anything. WEAVE ONE public account: each said act as it happens, its words verbatim, then the world's answer — the place's people doing what their own lines at this address say, a figure addressed answering from the place's own prose, small where the prose runs out. Present tense, third person. Name the players' characters as their passports name them, and the place's people by role or appearance — never by a name nobody has spoken aloud. A simple act simply succeeds inside the fold; only the uncertain, the costly and the will-deciding wait on a check (2.1). End with NEXT <address> — and before it WAY <place address> if someone goes. KEEP it: pscale_stream_engage(at=<this address>, keep='collective', keep_text=<the fold>, secret=<the keeper's key>). THE NIGHT IS BORN LOCKED at the first keep, under that key, and that key folds it ever after: the determiner is the lock, never a role. Without the door, read by hand: the voices (the engage at the address), the night so far — the gathering's ring (bsp block='temporal', spindle=<the gathering>, pscale_attention=0), the last folded beat whole, and when the ring is empty the last day's fold whole — each actor's passport whole (passport:<Handle>, spelled as the beach lists it), the place walked to the actors' Location at the scenario's beach (the placing stands at keeper:scene 3) with pscale_attention=-2, and for a check rules:nomad 1 and 4 with the world's rules at their root line; never keeper:<world>, never a hidden directory: you are given no motives, so give none.
2.1: A CHECK only where an act is genuinely uncertain and failing would cost, or where it decides another's will — one per such act, and a fold may carry two. The luck is nobody's to choose: it comes from this address and the actor's handle by the table's dice (the same exploding d10 the pool rolls, seeded temporal:<address>:<handle>), fixed before anyone reads it and the same for whoever recomputes it; the door lays each actor's luck in THE INPUT. Resolve by the scenario's rules — capability plus situation plus luck, less difficulty, read against the bands — and let anything short of clean success BITE in the fold: a durable change the next beat must reckon with, drawn only from what the place and the night already hold.
2.2: NEXT is the clock's only hand: the following beat of this gathering while the scene runs on (153 → 154); the first beat of the next gathering when the scene has plainly ended (158 → 161); and after a coarser fold, the first beat at which finer play resumes (100 folded → 211). Nothing else advances time.
2.3: FOLDING A COARSER RUNG — a gathering or the day is ripe only when every character present has said there instead of at the beat AND THE FINER RUNG IS AT REST. So first read the last finer fold beneath it whole and look at the address its NEXT names. If a line stands there unplayed that acts on a character or waits on their answer, or that fold left anyone in open danger or mid-exchange, THE FINER RUNG PULLS: keep nothing at the coarse address — fold that BEAT instead, by the ordinary law, weaving the lines that stand at it and taking each character's coarser line as what they are TRYING to do (the world answers the attempt), and end it NEXT <the following beat>; the coarser lines wait, voiced, where they are. When the finer rung is at rest, fold the coarse address at its own scale: BEGIN FROM where the last finer fold left everyone — in one sentence, never re-telling what a finer fold already holds — and carry it forward: what the span held for each of them, one check at that scale if one is owed, in a paragraph that contradicts nothing beneath it, ending NEXT <the first beat at which finer play resumes>. The beats already beneath it stay beneath it; your fold becomes the line that stands above them.

3._: THE LEAN is the keeper's other hand, after each fold and never before. THE DOOR COMPOSES IT: pscale_stream_engage(field='temporal', handle=<the keeper's>, at=<the address just folded>, beach=<this table>, tier='hard') gives the fold whole with its NEXT, the held side (the scenario's arc and the minds behind the faces, the place's hidden directory, the world's rules), and EACH FIGURE'S OWN LAST LINE. Voice what the place's people, and the day itself, DO NEXT: at most three, each ONE plain intention anyone present would see or hear, said at the fold's NEXT address in that figure's own mirror, named for its face (handle 'the-watch', 'the-stooped-man', 'the-day') under the keeper's key: pscale_stream_engage(field='temporal', handle=<the figure>, at=<NEXT>, say=<the line>, secret=<the keeper's key>). A FIGURE CONTINUES FROM ITS OWN LAST LINE — read it before you voice it; the day cannot end twice, and a man who has walked off is not still standing there. Never a reason, never a secret, never a name nobody has spoken. The next fold weaves these like any voice; a figure's mirror becomes its own record across the clock. Let the world move — but when the fold leaves the scene at rest and the characters are plainly withdrawing or settling, LET IT REST: voice nothing that acts on them at the next beat (a line of the day's own — the cold, the dark — at most), and let the world withdraw in ONE line, not three, so the beat is quiet and they may zoom out. After a COARSER fold, voice at its NEXT what the place's people do as finer play resumes, having read the last day's fold: whoever the night has already met is met again as known, never as a stranger. Without the door: keeper:<world> at the scenario's beach as a disc (pscale_attention=0) then ONE branch walked, the place's hidden directory (spindle='<Location digits>*'), and each figure's mirror at the last folded address.

4._: TIME MOVES BY FOLDING, and a party shares one rung at a time. TO ZOOM OUT — a scene's rest, a night's sleep, a day's walk — FIRST ENGAGE THE BEAT YOU STAND IN. If a line stands there that acts on you or yours, or waits on your answer — a companion's, or one of the place's people about to do something — the beat is LIVE and cannot be left: say at the beat (getting clear is itself a beat's act), and zoom out after a fold leaves you at rest. From a QUIET beat, say your disposition for the span at the coarser address that contains now — a rest at the gathering, a night at the day (1.5) — and write that address into your passport's Beat line; when everyone present stands at that rung and the finer rung is at rest, the keeper folds it at that scale (2.3) and names where finer play resumes. THE FINER RUNG PULLS: while anyone present still says at the beat, or a line stands there unplayed, the beat is played, and a coarser line simply waits, voiced, until the night lets everyone come up to it; a character whose beat was folded beneath them is pulled back down (1.5). TO ZOOM IN, say at a finer address than the fold named; the others are pulled down with you.

9._: THE LAW'S OWN RECORD — the second track's operator, version 5, written by weft on 2026-09-22 after the sealed trial's two passes (bsp-mcp proposals 2026-09-21-clock-trial-first-pass and 2026-09-22-clock-trial-corrective-pass): the zoom held on the second pass; what this version adds is the composed door for every act, the fog in the telling, the night born locked at the first fold, and the lean reading each figure's own last line. Its text lives in the router (src/tools/clock-law.json) and is written whole to function:temporal at a clock table when the table is founded; the pool's law, pscale:grit, is its elder and keeps at length the craft this compresses: grit 1.4 the act, 1.2 the telling, 2.4 the bite, 3.2 the world's next intentions.
